sloka: समुद्रं लङ्घयित्वा ऽहं शतयोजनमायतम् ।अगच्छं जानकीं सीतां मार्गमाणो दिदृक्षया ।। ५.६५.८ ।।।।
transliteration: samudraṁ laṅghayitvā 'haṁ śatayojanamāyatam ।agacchaṁ jānakīṁ sītāṁ mārgamāṇo didṛkṣayā ।। 5.65.8 ।।।।

translations.english: "Having crossed the sea consisting of a hundred yojanas in quest of Vaidehi, I found her.
